XJFH: Through truth and intuitive poise, great honor is obtained, with the Support of the Naam and the Glory of the Lord.
With Truth and Divine knowledge and the prop of god's praises and Name, man obtains great esteem.
9RY2: As it pleases You, Lord, please save and protect me. Without You, O my Husband Lord, who else is there for me? ||3||
Save me, O Spouse! as it pleases You. Except You, who else is mine?
1NJ0: Reading their books over and over again, people continue making mistakes; they are so proud of their religious robes.
By continually reading books men commit mistake and by wearing religious garbs they take great pride.
4GU7: But what is the use of bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, when the filth of stubborn pride is within the mind?
What does it avail man to bath at a place of pilgrimage, when the filth of self-conceit is within his mind.
BKUB: Other than the Guru, who can explain that within the mind is the Lord, the King, the Emperor? ||4||
Who except the Guru can explain that God, the King and Emperor, abides within man's mind.
7PFL: The Treasure of the Lord's Love is obtained by the Gurmukh, who contemplates the essence of reality.
By reflecting over the reality, through the Guru, the wealth of Lord's love is attained to.
V8DT: The bride eradicates her selfishness, and adorns herself with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
By decorating herself with the Guru's World, the bride has annulled her self-conceit.
UDVD: Within her own home, she finds her Husband, through infinite love for the Guru. ||5||
Through infinite love for the great Lord, she finds the Beloved in her own home.
C509: Applying oneself to the service of the Guru, the mind is purified, and peace is obtained.
In Guru's service and employment, the mind becomes pure and the mortal attains peace.
0QLB: The Word of the Guru's Shabad abides within the mind, and egotism is eliminated from within.
When the Guru's Word abides in the mind, egotism is eliminated from within.
EU03: The Treasure of the Naam is acquired, and the mind reaps the lasting profit. ||6||
The wealth of the Name is acquired and the mind ever gathers the Gain.
LTHE: If He grants His Grace, then we obtain it. We cannot find it by our own efforts.
If God's Grace is upon us, it is then that we obtain the Name. Of ourselves we cannot find it.
JCGJ: Remain attached to the Feet of the Guru, and eradicate selfishness from within.
Eradicate self-conceit from within you and remain attached to the Guru's feet.
P2XW: Attuned to Truth, you shall obtain the True One. ||7||
By Being imbued with the True Name, the True lord is obtained.
ULVK: Everyone makes mistakes; only the Guru and the Creator are infallible.
All are apt to commit an error. He Guru and the Creator alone are infallible.
J1QP: One who instructs his mind with the Guru's Teachings comes to embrace love for the Lord.
He who has chastened his mind through Guru's instruction comes to embrace Lord's love.
047U: O Nanak, do not forget the Truth; you shall receive the Infinite Word of the Shabad. ||8||12||
He, whom the Infinite lord gives this gift, forgets not the True Name O Nanak!
V57J: The enticing desire for Maya leads people to become emotionally attached to their children, relatives, households and spouses.
Because of the love of sons, relations and house-wife man is engrossed in the desire for fascinating mammon.
8Y44: The world is deceived and plundered by riches, youth, greed and egotism.
The world is beguiled by riches, youth avarice, covetousness and egotism.
E57B: The drug of emotional attachment has destroyed me, as it has destroyed the whole world. ||1||
The intoxicating herb, of secular love has killed me, so does the remaining world fare,(at its hands.)
YACX: O my Beloved, I have no one except You.
O my Beloved! I have no one but You.
9LZT: Without You, nothing else pleases me. Loving You, I am at peace. ||1||Pause||
Without You, nothing else is pleasing to me. By loving You I am at peace. Pause.
EWZR: I sing the Praises of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, with love; I am content with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Having acquired contentment by Guru's instruction, I praise God's Name with love!
5H35: Whatever is seen shall pass away. So do not be attached to this false show.
What so ever is seen, that shall depart. Have not affections for the false show.
YRQ6: Like a traveller in his travels, you have come. Behold the caravan leaving each day. ||2||
You have come like a traveler on the way. See that your company is passing away each day.
01WT: Many preach sermons, but without the Guru, understanding is not obtained.
Many a man preach sermons, but without the Guru, Divine Understanding is not obtained.
VKD3: If someone receives the Glory of the Naam, he is attuned to truth and blessed with honor.
If one receives the glory of the Name, he is imbued with Truth and gains honour.
WN0Y: Those who are pleasing to You are good; no one is counterfeit or genuine. ||3||
They, who are pleasing to You, are good. (In oneself) none is counterfeit or genuine.
PDKK: In the Guru's Sanctuary we are saved. The assets of the self-willed manmukhs are false.
By taking the protection of the Guru, man is saved. Counterfeit is the capital of the wayward persons.
YYRW: The eight metals of the King are made into coins by the Word of His Shabad.
The eight metals of the King are fashioned (into coins) to His order and pleasure.
03UN: The Assayer Himself assays them, and He places the genuine ones in His Treasury. ||4||
The Assayer Himself assays the coins, and consigns the genuine to His treasury.
JHLY: Your Value cannot be appraised; I have seen and tested everything.
Your worth cannot be ascertained. I have seen and tested everything.
JGBW: By speaking, His Depth cannot be found. Abiding in truth, honor is obtained.
By saying His fathom cannot be fond. If man abides in Truth, He obtains honour.
0R2V: Through the Guru's Teachings, I praise You; otherwise, I cannot describe Your Value. ||5||
By Guru's instructions, O lord! I praise You. There is no other way to describe Your worth.
8UVP: That body which does not appreciate the Naam-that body is infested with egotism and conflict.
The body which likes not the Name that body is infested with pride and strife.
JTGY: Without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained; other tastes are poison.
Without the Guru, Divine Comprehensions, is not obtained, other relishes are but poison.
NZET: Without virtue, nothing is of any use. The taste of Maya is bland and insipid. ||6||
Without virtue nothing avails. Insipid is the taste of riches.
VS63: Through desire, people are cast into the womb and reborn. Through desire, they taste the sweet and sour flavors.
In hope the man is born, and in hope he partakes of the savoury and citreous dainties.
S45P: Bound by desire, they are led on, beaten and struck on their faces and mouths.
Trapped by desire, He is goaded on and bears blows on his face again and again.
L3UZ: Bound and gagged and assaulted by evil, they are released only through the Name, through the Guru's Teachings. ||7||
Bound down by sin, he is struck and its released by remembering the Name under Guru's instruction.2

9JG3: In all places, You are the One and Only. As it pleases You, Lord, please save and protect me!
At all the places You alone are, O Master! save me as it pleases You.
GW6T: Through the Guru's Teachings, the True One abides within the mind. The Companionship of the Naam brings the most excellent honor.
Under Guru's instruction, the True Name abides in man's mind. In the company of the Name he wins sublime honour.
3ELC: Eradicate the disease of egotism, and chant the True Shabad, the Word of the True Lord. ||8||
Having eradicated the disease of egotism, he repeats the True Name of the True lord.
ZNJH: You are pervading throughout the Akaashic Ethers, the nether regions and the three worlds.
You, O Lord! art contained in firmament, nether region and the three worlds.
E107: You Yourself are bhakti, loving devotional worship. You Yourself unite us in Union with Yourself.
You Yourself are devotion and affection and Yourself unitest in Your union.
PT38: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam! As is Your Pleasure, so is Your Will. ||9||13||
May Nanak never forget Your Name, O Lord! As it pleases You, so does Your Will work.
X8UR: My mind is pierced through by the Name of the Lord. What else should I contemplate?
With Pervading Lord's Name, my mind is pierced through. What else should I reflect upon?
XA0N: Focusing your awareness on the Shabad, happiness wells up. Attuned to God, the most excellent peace is found.
By fixing attention on the Divine word happiness is procured. Imbued with the Lord, sublime joy emanates.
NPBU: As it pleases You, please save me, Lord. The Name of the Lord is my Support. ||1||
Preserve me as it pleases You, O God! Your Name is my mainstay.
AQF7: O mind, the Will of our Lord and Master is true.
O My Soul! just is the will of the Master.
LPSB: Focus your love upon the One who created and adorned your body and mind. ||1||Pause||
Contract love with Him who has made and adorned your body and soul. Pause.
G9AZ: If I cut my body into pieces, and burn them in the fire,
Were I to cut my body into an atom weight pieces and burn it in fire.
JDBX: and if I make my body and mind into firewood, and night and day burn them in the fire,
If I make my body and soul into fuel, and night and day, burn them in fire,
WP4V: and if I perform hundreds of thousands and millions of religious rituals-still, all these are not equal to the Name of the Lord. ||2||
and if I perform lakhs and millions of religious rites, all these becomes not equal to God's Name.
N4KG: If my body were cut in half, if a saw was put to my head,
If my body be got frozen in the (snow of) Himalayas; even then soul shall not be free from disease.
SJAC: and if my body were frozen in the Himalayas-even then, my mind would not be free of disease.
Were a saw to be applied to my head and my body be cut in two halves,
1L57: None of these are equal to the Name of the Lord. I have seen and tried and tested them all. ||3||
These equal not God's Name. All this I have seen by test and trial.
7LEC: If I made a donation of castles of gold, and gave lots of fine horses and wondrous elephants in charity,
Were I to give in alms castles of gold, and give in charity good many fine horses and excellent elephants,
JGRX: and if I made donations of land and cows-even then, pride and ego would still be within me.
and were I to donate land and many cows, even then pride and ego will remain within my mind.
9D20: The Name of the Lord has pierced my mind; the Guru has given me this true gift. ||4||
Pervading God's Name has penetrated my mind. This is the true gift the Guru has given me.
9G8U: There are so many stubborn-minded intelligent people, and so many who contemplate the Vedas.
How many men of perseverance and intelligence there are and how many there are contemplators of Vedas?
VFS4: There are so many entanglements for the soul. Only as Gurmukh do we find the Gate of Liberation.
How many entanglements there are for the soul it is only through the Guru that the gate of emancipation is obtained.
83GC: Truth is higher than everything; but higher still is truthful living. ||5||
(As) everything is underneath Truth, the living with the Truth is superior to all.
YTKU: Call everyone exalted; no one seems lowly.
Call every one exalted, none appears to be base.
K5B1: The One Lord has fashioned the vessels, and His One Light pervades the three worlds.
The One Lord has fashioned the pots, and One Light is pervading the three worlds.
XKHS: Receiving His Grace, we obtain Truth. No one can erase His Primal Blessing. ||6||
Through God's grace Truth is attained to. None can efface the primordial gift.
DD6R: When one Holy person meets another Holy person, they abide in contentment, through the Love of the Guru.
When a saint meets a saint, through the love of the Guru, he obtains contentment.
ML17: They contemplate the Unspoken Speech, merging in absorption in the True Guru.
If man merges in the True Guru, he comes to reflect over the discourse of the Ineffable Lord.
XGPD: Drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar, they are contented; they go to the Court of the Lord in robes of honor. ||7||
By quaffing Nectar he is satisfied and goes to God's Court, clad in robe of honour.
YLW7: In each and every heart the Music of the Lord's Flute vibrates, night and day, with sublime love for the Shabad.
The flute resounds night and day within all the hearts which bear sublime love to God's Name.
T04W: Only those few who become Gurmukh understand this by instructing their minds.
Rare are they who procure understanding by admonishing their soul, through the Guru.
L3WW: O Nanak, do not forget the Naam. Practicing the Shabad you shall be saved. ||8||14||
Nanak! they who forget not God's Name and act according to Guru's instruction are delivered.
0T08: There are painted mansions to behold, white-washed, with beautiful doors;
We see painted mansions with white-washed and beautiful doors.
K2DW: they were constructed to give pleasure to the mind, but this is only for the sake of the love of duality.
They were constructed to give pleasure to the mind. But all this is love and attachment of mammon.
QZEF: The inner being is empty without love. The body shall crumble into a heap of ashes. ||1||
The inner-self is empty without Lord's love. The body shall crumble down into a heap of ashes.
7EPN: O Siblings of Destiny, this body and wealth shall not go along with you.
O Brother! the body and wealth shall not accompany you.
XG9C: The Lord's Name is the pure wealth; through the Guru, God bestows this gift. ||1||Pause||
Pervading Lord's Name is the pure Wealth. That Lord gives this gift, through the Guru. Pause.
253F: The Lord's Name is the pure wealth; it is given only by the Giver.
Lord's Name is Immaculate Wealth, only if the Giver were to give it to man.
FDPR: One who has the Guru, the Creator, as his Friend, shall not be questioned hereafter.
Whose friend is the great Creator he is not questioned hereafter.
HTED: He Himself delivers those who are delivered. He Himself is the Forgiver. ||2||
If God Himself delivers man. he is delivered for He Himself is the pardoner.3

UHS6: The self-willed manmukh looks upon his daughters, sons and relatives as his own.
The perverse person deems the daughters, sons and relatives to be his own.
XDWN: Gazing upon his wife, he is pleased. But along with happiness, they bring grief.
He is pleased on beholding his wife. But they bring weal coupled with woe.
U48N: The Gurmukhs are attuned to the Word of the Shabad. Day and night, they enjoy the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||
The pious persons are imbued with God's Name and day and night they enjoy Lord's elixir.
Z9ZV: The consciousness of the wicked, faithless cynics wanders around in search of transitory wealth, unstable and distracted.
The mind of the unstable and wavering infidel wanders in quest of transitory wealth.
R4W5: Searching outside of themselves, they are ruined; the object of their search is in that sacred place within the home of the heart.
Men ruin themselves by their search without while the Thing is in the sacred place of their home.
3C2E: The self-willed manmukhs, in their ego, miss it; the Gurmukhs receive it in their laps. ||4||
The pious receive it in their lap, while the perverse miss it through ego.
UENG: You worthless, faithless cynic-recognize your own origin!
O vicious mammon worshipper! recognise your own origin.
DCTC: This body is made of blood and semen. It shall be consigned to the fire in the end.
This body is made from blood and semen and shall be taken (consigned) to fire.
0SG7: The body is under the power of the breath, according to the True Sign inscribed upon your forehead. ||5||
According to the true mark on the brow (fate) the body is in the power of breath.
23JV: Everyone begs for a long life-no one wishes to die.
Everyone asks for long life and no one wishes to die.
RR99: A life of peace and comfort comes to that Gurmukh, within whom God dwells.
Comfortable life is said to be his within that Lord abides, through the Guru.
ZP0M: Without the Naam, what good those who do not have the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Lord and Guru? ||6||
Of what account are they, who are without the Name and who therefore obtain not the sight of the Guru and God.
0234: In their dreams at night, people wander around as long as they sleep;
As a man goes astray in dream at night, till his sleep lasts;
Z109: just so, they are under the power of the snake Maya, as long as their hearts are filled with ego and duality.
so does amiss the mortal within whose heart is ego and love of duality and who is in the power of the mammon serpent.
LGJN: Through the Guru's Teachings, they come to understand and see that this world is just a dream. ||7||
Through Guru's instruction, does mortal realise and see that this world is but a dream.
QNQ6: As thirst is quenched with water, and the baby is satisfied with mother's milk,
As fire is quenched with water as the baby is satiated with mother's milk.
S162: and as the lotus does not exist without water, and as the fish dies without water
As lotus exists not without water, and as the fish perishes sans water;
SNDG: -O Nanak, so does the Gurmukh live, receiving the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||8||15||
So does Nanak live by singing God's praises and obtaining Lord's elixir through the Guru.
8YJX: Beholding the terrifying mountain in this world of my father's home, I am terrified.
I am terrified on beholding the terrible mountain in my father's home (this world)
3YLS: It is so difficult to climb this high mountain; there is no ladder which reaches up there.
High and difficult to ascend is the mountain, No ladder is there which will reach it.
LKFS: But as Gurmukh, I know that it is within my self; the Guru has brought me to Union, and so I cross over. ||1||
Through the Guru, I have recognised the Mountain within me. The Guru has united me with Him and I am saved.
8A9U: O Siblings of Destiny, the terrifying world-ocean is so difficult to cross-I am terrified!
O Brother! the fearful world-ocean is arduous and awe-inspiring.
4ZBG: The Perfect True Guru, in His Pleasure, has met with me; the Guru has saved me, through the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
By his pleasure the Perfect True Guru has met me and by granting God's Name he has delivered me. Pause.
887C: I may say, "I am going, I am going", but I know that, in the end, I must really go.
If I say, "I am to go and depart", it will not avail me. If however I really realise that I am apt to depart, if will.
SV69: Whoever comes must also go. Only the Guru and the Creator are Eternal.
Who-so-ever is come, he shall go, only the Sublime Guru and the Creator are Eternal.
VX31: So praise the True One continually, and love His Place of Truth. ||2||
Ever eulogise the True One and enshrine affection for His True abode.
TAZC: Beautiful gates, houses and palaces, solidly built forts,
The beautiful gate-ways, houses, palace and thousands of solidly built forts;
68ZJ: elephants, saddled horses, hundreds of thousands of uncounted armies
these go not with any one. With them, the fools get distracted and bothered and finally die.
KNWK: -none of these will go along with anyone in the end, and yet, the fools bother themselves to exhaustion with these, and then die. ||3||
these go not with any one. With them, the fools get distracted and bothered and finally die.
AW9U: You may gather gold and sliver, but wealth is just a net of entanglement.
Man may amass gold and silver but wealth is an entangling net.
XX18: You may beat the drum and proclaim authority over the whole world, but without the Name, death hovers over your head.
He may proclaim his authority, by beat of drum in the whole world but without the Name death stands over his head.
81KW: When the body falls, the play of life is over; what shall be the condition of the evil-doers then? ||4||
When the body falls, the life's play is over. What shall be the condition of evil-doers then?
Y4RY: The husband is delighted seeing his sons, and his wife upon his bed.
The husband delights on beholding his sons and his wife on the couch.
GW94: He applies sandalwood and scented oils, and dresses himself in his beautiful clothes.
He applies essence of aloe wood and sandal and bedecks himself with beautiful clothes.
P594: But dust shall mix with dust, and he shall depart, leaving hearth and home behind. ||5||
Leaving his hearth and home he depart and dust mixes with dust.
MGE4: He may be called a chief, an emperor, a king, a governor or a lord;
He may be called a chief, an emperor, a king, a governor or a Lord.
FBQL: he may present himself as a leader or a chief, but this just burns him in the fire of egotistical pride.
He may be styled a headman or a duke, but all this is burning and igniting with egotism.
E9SD: The self-willed manmukh has forgotten the Naam. He is like straw, burning in the forest fire. ||6||
The perverse person has forgotten God's Name. He is like a reed burnt with jungle fire.4
NV21: Whoever comes into the world and indulges in ego, must depart.
Who so ever is come in this world he is awfully infested with pride and is bound to depart.

AB07: The whole world is a store-house of lamp-black; the body and mind are blackened with it.
The entire world is a chamber of lampblack. the body, soul and human Frame are all blackened therewith.
VW84: Those who are saved by the Guru are immaculate and pure; through the Word of the Shabad, they extinguish the fire of desire. ||7||
They, whom the Guru preserves are pure and with God's Name, extinguish the fire of desires.
ZTM0: O Nanak, they swim across with the True Name of the Lord, the King above the heads of kings.
Nanak, man swims across with the True Name of the king over the head of kings.
9ZTN: May I never forget the Name of the Lord! I have purchased the Jewel of the Lord's Name.
May I not forget God's Name, I have purchased the jewel of God's Name.
DF9J: The self-willed manmukhs putrefy and die in the terrifying world-ocean, while the Gurmukhs cross over the bottomless ocean. ||8||16||
The wayward putrefy and die in the terrible ocean (world) and the Guru-wards cross the unfathomable ocean.
MUXT: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Second House:
XS09: They have made this their resting place and they sit at home, but the urge to depart is always there.
Making it an halting place, the mortal sits at home but he ever has the lurking sense to depart.
P1JY: This would be known as a lasting place of rest, only if they were to remain stable and unchanging. ||1||
If the mortals were to remain ever stable, then alone, it could be deemed to be a permanent place of rest.
UXHX: What sort of a resting place is this world?
What king of halting station is this world.
AGKE: Doing deeds of faith, pack up the supplies for your journey, and remain committed to the Name. ||1||Pause||
Tie up the viaticum of doing deeds of faith and remain attached to the Lord's Name. Pause.
THC4: The Yogis sit in their Yogic postures, and the Mullahs sit at their resting stations.
The Yogi squats in devotional posture and the Mullah sits at a place of rest.
NK97: The Hindu Pandits recite from their books, and the Siddhas sit in the temples of their gods. ||2||
The Brahmans recite books and the men of miracles sit in God's temples.
KJVZ: The angels, Siddhas, worshippers of Shiva, heavenly musicians, silent sages, Saints, priests, preachers, spiritual teachers and commanders
The demigods, perfect-persons, worshippers, of Shiva, Heavenly, Musician, silent sages, saint, religious instructors, spiritual guides and commanders,
7Q8D: -each and every one has left, and all others shall depart as well. ||3||
have all left stage by stage, and others too are under orders of departure.
GP6M: The sultans and kings, the rich and the mighty, have marched away in succession.
The Kings, chiefs, angles and nobles have marched away in succession.
2A2T: In a moment or two, we shall also depart. O my heart, understand that you must go as well! ||4||
The mortal must march away in a moment or two. O My! heart understand that you, too, are about to reach there.
HMUD: This is described in the Shabads; only a few understand this!
In Divine hymns it is so described. Only the rare understand this.
M6YX: Nanak offers this prayer to the One who pervades the water, the land and the air. ||5||
Nanak makes a supplication. The Lord is contained is water, dry-land, nether-region and firmament.
LLT6: He is Allah, the Unknowable, the Inaccessible, All-powerful and Merciful Creator.
He is the unseen, inscrutable inaccessible, omnipotent and bounteous Creator.
HR4Z: All the world comes and goes-only the Merciful Lord is permanent. ||6||
The entire world is subject to coming and going. The Merciful Lord alone is permanent.
5E2W: Call permanent only the One, who does not have destiny inscribed upon His Forehead.
Call him permanent whose head bears not a writ of destiny.
J70E: The sky and the earth shall pass away; He alone is permanent. ||7||
The sky and earth shall pass away. Ever stable is He alone.
2S1L: The day and the sun shall pass away; the night and the moon shall pass away; the hundreds of thousands of stars shall disappear.
The day and the sun shall depart, the night and the moon shall vanish and hundreds of thousands of stars shall disappear.
SJC2: He alone is permanent; Nanak speaks the Truth. ||8||17||
He alone is eternal. Nanak tells the truth.
3UFU: Seventeen Ashtpadheeyaa Of The First Mehl.
Seventeen ashtpadies of the first Guru.
8P3E: Siree Raag, Third Mehl, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa:
Sri Rag, Third Guru. Eight Stanzas.
Q3CC: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By the True Guru's grace He is obtained.
YX6Q: By God's Grace, the Gurmukh practices devotion; without the Guru, there is no devotional worship.
By the Guru's grace God's meditation is embraced. Without the Guru, Lord's devotional service is not performed.
C7SZ: One who merges his own self into Him understands, and so becomes pure.
Any one, who merge his ownself in the Guru then, becomes pure by understanding the Lord.
5FGN: The Dear Lord is True, and True is the Word of His Bani. Through the Word of the Shabad, Union with Him is obtained. ||1||
True is the honourable Lord and True is his Gurbani. It is through the Word that union with God is effected.
YWVX: O Siblings of Destiny, without devotion, why have people even come into the world?
O Brother! what for has the mortal, bereft of Lord's service and meditation, come into this world?
PTHB: They have not served the Perfect Guru; they have wasted their lives in vain. ||1||Pause||
He has not served the Perfect Guru and has wasted his life in vain. Pause.
14B2: The Lord Himself, the Life of the World, is the Giver. He Himself forgives, and unites us with Himself.
God, the bestower is Himself the life of the world and granting pardon, Himself unites man with Him ownself.
5BHH: What are these poor beings and creatures? What can they speak and say?
What are these poor living beings? what can they say and tell?
5TCY: God Himself grants glory to the Gurmukhs; He joins them to His Service. ||2||
To the saint He Himself grants glory and Himself yokes to His service.5
1SQ7: Beholding your family, you are lured away by emotional attachment, but when you leave, they will not go with you.
On beholding your kith and kin, you are enticed by their love but they go not with you at your departure.

AQXH: Serving the True Guru, I have found the Treasure of Excellence. Its value cannot be estimated.
By serving the True Guru I have obtained the treasure of excellence and Its worth cannot be appraised.
2JAL: The Dear Lord God is my Best Friend. In the end, He shall be my Companion and Support. ||3||
The venerable Lord God is my Friend and at the last moment shall be my Succourer.
FJ8R: In this world of my father's home, the Great Giver is the Life of the World. The self-willed manmukhs have lost their honor.
Beneficent Lord, the life of world, is in the parents home (this world). Ignoring Him the infidel has lost his honour.
QGK9: Without the True Guru, no one knows the Way. The blind find no place of rest.
Sans the True Guru, none knows the way to God. The blind find no place of rest.
TDPQ: If the Lord, the Giver of Peace, does not dwell within the mind, then they shall depart with regret in the end. ||4||
If God the giver of peace dwells not in man's mind, he departs regretting at the end.
MCZP: In this world of my father's house, through the Guru's Teachings, I have cultivated within my mind the Great Giver, the Life of the World.
Under Guru's instruction in my father's house (in this world) I have caused to dwell within my mind generous Lord the life of the universe.
8MLQ: Night and day, performing devotional worship, day and night, ego and emotional attachment are removed.
He, who ever meditates on the Lord, day and night, annuls his ego and worldly love.
ZXGP: And then, attuned to Him, we become like Him, truly absorbed in the True One. ||5||
He, then becomes like Him with whom he is imbued and truly gets absorbed in the True Being.
16MN: Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He gives us His Love, and we contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
By His grace God blesses man with His love and he ponders through Guru's word.
0WQ1: Serving the True Guru, intuitive peace wells up, and ego and desire die.
By serving the True Guru spring peace and poise and one's ego and desire are stilled.
LV3F: The Lord, the Giver of Virtue, dwells forever within the minds of those who keep Truth enshrined within their hearts. ||6||
God the giver of virtue, ever abides within the mind of him who keeps the Truth clasped to his heart.
D4GV: My God is forever Immaculate and Pure; with a pure mind, He can be found.
Eternally immaculate is my Lord with pure mind He is procured.
U1F9: If the Treasure of the Name of the Lord abides within the mind, egotism and pain are totally eliminated.
If the treasure of God's Name abides in the mind one's ego and sorrow are all eliminated.
4X8J: The True Guru has instructed me in the Word of the Shabad. I am forever a sacrifice to Him. ||7||
The True Guru has preached to me the Lord's Name, I am ever a sacrifice to him.
WYSA: Within your own conscious mind, you may say anything, but without the Guru, selfishness and conceit are not eradicated.
Without the Guru self-conceit is not annulled. Within his mind and heart one may say or cause to be said anything.
3S9J: The Dear Lord is the Lover of His devotees, the Giver of Peace. By His Grace, He abides within the mind.
Reverend God is the Lover of His saints and the Giver of Peace. By His grace he abides in man's mind.
D88D: O Nanak, God blesses us with the sublime awakening of consciousness; He Himself grants glorious greatness to the Gurmukh. ||8||1||18||
Nanak the Lord blesses man with sublime awakening and Himself grants him honour and glory through the Guru.
6R45: Those who go around acting in egotism are struck down by the Messenger of Death with his club.
The rod of the angel of death smites those who go about their business in pride.
MVQ2: Those who serve the True Guru are uplifted and saved, in love with the Lord. ||1||
They who serve the True Guru and contract affection with the Lord are delivered.
5D9G: O mind, become Gurmukh, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
O My soul! through the Guru, meditate on Lord's Name.
Q68U: Those who are so pre-destined by the Creator are absorbed into the Naam, through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||
They who are so pre-ordained by God the Creator by Guru's instruction get absorbed in the name. pause.
V55Z: Without the True Guru, faith does not come, and love for the Naam is not embraced.
Without the True Guru one acquires not faith nor does he embrace love for the name.
4ESY: Even in dreams, they find no peace; they sleep immersed in pain. ||2||
He obtains not peace even in dream and sleeps and dies in pain.
M15F: Even if you chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, with great longing, your past actions are still not erased.
If he greatly longs for Lord God and utters His Name too his past actions cannot be erased.
Y0D1: The Lord's devotees surrender to His Will; those devotees are accepted at His Door. ||3||
The saints submit to God's will; such saints are accepted at his door.
0SMZ: The Guru has lovingly implanted the Word of His Shabad within me. Without His Grace, it cannot be attained.
The Guru firmly installs God's Name with love but without His grace the name cannot be attained to.
PJAJ: Even if the poisonous plant is watered with ambrosial nectar a hundred times, it will still bear poisonous fruit. ||4||
Through the poisonous plant be irrigated with Nectar a hundred times still it shall quickly bear poisonous fruits.
1ZT7: Those humble beings who are in love with the True Guru are pure and true.
Truthful and pure are the persons who bear love to the True Guru.
U2FU: They act in harmony with the Will of the True Guru; they shed the poison of ego and corruption. ||5||
They practise True Guru's will and shed the poison of ego and evil.
1PK4: Acting in stubborn-mindedness, no one is saved; go and study the Simritees and the Shaastras.
By no effort through mind's obstinacy one can be delivered. Go and thoroughly study the Simirtis and Shashtras.
9WPN: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and practicing the Shabads of the Guru, you shall be saved. ||6||
By meeting the society of saints and acting up to Guru's instruction the mortal is saved.
V4H3: The Name of the Lord is the Treasure, which has no end or limitation.
God's Name is the treasure of excellences which has no limit this or that end.
PUNF: The Gurmukhs are beauteous; the Creator has blessed them with His Mercy. ||7||
The Guruwards to whom the Creator shows mercy look beauteous.
28N9: O Nanak, the One Lord alone is the Giver; there is no other at all.
Nanak the Lord alone is the donour there is no other second.
4Z1A: By Guru's Grace, He is obtained. By His Mercy, He is found. ||8||2||19||
By Guru's grace the Lord is obtained and it is through good luck that the Guru is met.6

7VH2: The soul-bird in the beautiful tree of the body pecks at Truth, with love for the Guru.
With Guru's love in the heart the beauteous bird on the tree pecks at truth.
EE1X: She drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, and abides in intuitive ease; she does not fly around coming and going.
It drinks God's Nectar abides in celestial bliss and flies not nor comes and goes.
NS8L: She obtains her home within her own heart; she is absorbed into the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
It obtains dwelling in its own home and is absorbed in Lord God's Name.
CDGW: O mind, work to serve the Guru.
O My Soul! do you perform Guru's service.
2V8L: If you walk in harmony with the Guru's Will, you shall remain immersed in the Lord's Name, night and day. ||1||Pause||
If you actest in accordance with Guru's will then you shall remain merged in God's Name night and day. Pause.
LYCV: The birds in the beautiful trees fly around in all four directions.
The birds of the beautiful trees fly and go in four directions.
DLRM: The more they fly around, the more they suffer; they burn and cry out in pain.
The more they fly (up) the more they suffer. They ever burn and bewail.
3SU5: Without the Guru, they do not find the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and they do not obtain the Ambrosial Fruit. ||2||
Without the Guru they behold not God's mansion nor obtain the ambrosial fruit.
5GYF: The Gurmukh is like God's tree, always green, blessed with the Sublime Love of the True One, with intuitive peace and poise.
The true Sikh of the Guru is like God's ever green tree. He is automatically blessed with the love of the True Lord.
0RQW: He cuts off the three branches of the three qualities, and embraces love for the One Word of the Shabad.
He lops off the three branches (qualities) and embraces love for One Word.
VJ0E: The Lord alone is the Ambrosial Fruit; He Himself gives it to us to eat. ||3||
God's Name alone is the ambrosial fruit. He Himself gives it to be eaten.
94EA: The self-willed manmukhs stand there and dry up; they do not bear any fruit, and they do not provide any shade.
The perverse get dried up standing. They have no fruit or shadow.
JQX3: Don't even bother to sit near them-they have no home or village.
Sit not near them they have no home or village.
CDLY: They are cut down and burnt each day; they have neither the Shabad, nor the Lord's Name. ||4||
They are ever cut down and burnt. They have neither Word nor God's Name.
6PS1: According to the Lord's Command, people perform their actions; they wander around, driven by the karma of their past actions.
Men act according to Lord's command and wander in accordance with their previous actions.
PNKL: By the Lord's Command, they behold the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. Wherever He sends them, there they go.
By God's flat they behold His sight and whither He sends them thither they go.
JVJH: By His Command, the Lord, Har, Har, abides within our minds; by His Command we merge in Truth. ||5||
By his order Lord God abides in man's mind and by His order he is absorbed in Truth.
S49X: The wretched fools do not know the Lord's Will; they wander around making mistakes.
The ignorant wretches know not Lord's will and go amiss in error.
YNNH: They go about their business stubborn-mindedly; they are disgraced forever and ever.
With mind's obstinacy they go about their business and are disgraced for ever and aye.
KAR6: Inner peace does not come to them; they do not embrace love for the True Lord. ||6||
They gather not inner peace and embrace not love for the True Lord.
PC75: Beautiful are the faces of the Gurmukhs, who bear love and affection for the Guru.
Beauteous are the faces of Guru's slaves, who bear love and affection to the Guru.
3R0B: Through true devotional worship, they are attuned to Truth; at the True Door, they are found to be true.
Theirs is the genuine worship they are imbued with Truth and at the True Door they are found true.
D59N: Blessed is their coming into being; they redeem all their ancestors. ||7||
Acceptable (blest) is the advent (birth) of those they save their entire lineage.
C1UT: All do their deeds under the Lord's Glance of Grace; no one is beyond His Vision.
Every one does the deeds under Lord's eye. None is beyond His glance.
KYH3: According to the Glance of Grace with which the True Lord beholds us, so do we become.
As is the gracious glance with which the True Lord beholds the man so does he become.
MS7J: O Nanak, the Glorious Greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is received only by His Mercy. ||8||3||20||
Nanak, the glorious greatness of the Name of God is obtained by His mercy.
CNLX: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam; the self-willed manmukhs do not understand.
The Guruwards dwell on the Name and the selfwards obtain not understanding.
UQ1Q: The faces of the Gurmukhs are always radiant; the Lord has come to dwell within their minds.
Ever-bright are the countenances of the Guruwards. God has come to dwell within their mind.
BC5T: Through intuitive understanding they are at peace, and through intuitive understanding they remain absorbed in the Lord. ||1||
Through Divine understanding they obtain celestial peace and through Divine understanding they remain absorbed in the Lord.
SW7A: O Siblings of Destiny, be the slaves of the Lord's slaves.
O Brother! be you the slave of God's slaves.
2TXA: Service to the Guru is worship of the Guru. How rare are those who obtain it! ||1||Pause||
Guru's service is Guru's worship. Hardly any one obtains it. Pause.
9PCG: The happy soul-bride is always with her Husband Lord, if she walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.
If the happy bride acts according to the Will of the True Guru she shall ever enjoy her Husband.
E45M: She attains her Eternal, Ever-stable Husband, who never dies or goes away.
To the eternal and immovable spouse she attains. He neither dies nor goes.
1QQN: United with the Word of the Shabad, she shall not be separated again. She is immersed in the Lap of her Beloved. ||2||
United with the Word she separates not rather sinks into the lap of her Beloved.
FFAP: The Lord is Immaculate and Radiantly Bright; without the Guru, He cannot be found.
The Lord is immaculate and exceedingly effulgent. Without the Guru He is not obtained.
Y3AS: He cannot be understood by reading scriptures; the deceitful pretenders are deluded by doubt.
By reading scriptures one understands Him not. The pretenders have gone astray in doubt.
AZX8: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord is always found, and the tongue is permeated with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||
By Guru's instruction immortal God is attained to and the tongue remains permeated with Lord's elixir.7
BZGK: Emotional attachment to Maya is shed with intuitive ease, through the Guru's Teachings.
By Guru's instruction one effortlessly sheds one's love of mammon.

TG5F: Without the Shabad, the world wanders lost in pain. The self-willed manmukh is consumed.
Without the Name the world wanders in agony. The mammon has eaten-up the wayward.
F5M3: Through the Shabad, meditate on the Naam; through the Shabad, you shall merge in Truth. ||4||
Through the Word one meditates on the Name and through the word he gets absorbed in the True One.
VAH7: The Siddhas wander around, deluded by Maya; they are not absorbed in the Samaadhi of the Lord's Sublime Love.
The man of miracles roam about misled by mammon and they embrace not contemplation in sublime love.
V9Q0: The three worlds are permeated by Maya; they are totally covered by it.
Mammon is pervading the three worlds and is greatly clinging to the mortals.
XK1B: Without the Guru, liberation is not attained, and the double-mindedness of Maya does not go away. ||5||
Without the Guru, emancipation is not gained nor do double mindedness and secular love depart.
CV7Q: What is called Maya? What does Maya do?
Whom do men call mammon? What work does mammon do?
LQCE: These beings are bound by pleasure and pain; they do their deeds in egotism.
In woe and weal mammon has enchained this mortal and caused him to go about his business in ego.
ZMW7: Without the Shabad, doubt is not dispelled, and egotism is not eliminated from within. ||6||
Without Divine Word, doubt is not dispelled nor does pride depart from within.
227K: Without love, there is no devotional worship. Without the Shabad, no one finds acceptance.
Without love Lord's service cannot be performed, and without the Name one becomes not acceptable.
SEKA: Through the Shabad, egotism is conquered and subdued, and the illusion of Maya is dispelled.
With the Name ego is stilled and mammon's illusion departs.
EM27: The Gurmukh obtains the Treasure of the Naam with intuitive ease. ||7||
Through the Guru, man easily obtains the wealth of God's Name.
7QAB: Without the Guru, one's virtues do not shine forth; without virtue, there is no devotional worship.
Sans the Guru, virtues shine not and sans virtues Lord's devotional service cannot be performed.
J2SB: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He abides within their minds. They meet that God with intuitive ease.
That Lord easily meets the mortal, within whose mind the Name of God, the lover of devotion abides.
J0LX: O Nanak, through the Shabad, praise the Lord. By His Grace, He is obtained. ||8||4||21||
Nanak, through the Word do you praise God. By His grace, is He obtained.
8J36: Emotional attachment to Maya is created by my God; He Himself misleads us through illusion and doubt.
Attachment of mammon is the creation of my Master, and He Himself misleads man into an illusion.
60AP: The self-willed manmukhs perform their actions, but they do not understand; they waste away their lives in vain.
The self-willed do misleads and understand not. They lose their life in vain.
4UN5: Gurbani is the Light to illuminate this world; by His Grace, it comes to abide within the mind. ||1||
Gurbani is the Divine Light in this world. Through God's grace does it come to abide is mortal's mind.
ETA7: O mind, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and find peace.
O Man! meditate you on the Name so that you may obtain peace.
FGP5: Praising the Perfect Guru, you shall easily meet with that God. ||1||Pause||
By eulogising the perfect Guru, that Lord easily meets the man. Pause.
EB3Y: Doubt departs, and fear runs away, when you focus your consciousness on the Lord's Feet.
By fixing attention on God's feet man's doubt departs and fear flees.
USTN: The Gurmukh practices the Shabad, and the Lord comes to dwell within the mind.
By practising the Name through the Guru, God comes and dwells within the mind.
Z5RC: In the mansion of the home within the self, we merge in Truth, and the Messenger of Death cannot devour us. ||2||
Through truth, man merges in his real Self in his home, and death's myrmidon can devour him not.
2UG5: Naam Dayv the printer, and Kabeer the weaver, obtained salvation through the Perfect Guru.
Nam Dev, the calico-printer and Kabir, the weaver, obtained salvation from the perfect Guru.
VC56: Those who know God and recognize His Shabad lose their ego and class consciousness.
By recognising His Name they became the knowers of God and lost their ego and caste
JM7R: Their Banis are sung by the angelic beings, and no one can erase them, O Siblings of Destiny! ||3||
Demigods and men sing their hymns. None can erase them, O Brother!
MT80: The demon's son Prahlaad had not read about religious rituals or ceremonies, austerity or self-discipline; he did not know the love of duality.
(Prahlad), the demon's son, read not of religious rites and austerities, for he knew not duality.
FABA: Upon meeting with the True Guru, he became pure; night and day, he chanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
On meeting the True Guru, he become pure, and uttered God's Name night and day.
A94C: He read only of the One and he understood only the One Name; he knew no other at all. ||4||
He read only of One God, realised but One Name and knew no other second.
X4LS: The followers of the six different life-styles and world-views, the Yogis and the Sanyaasees have gone astray in doubt without the Guru.
The followers of six schools of philosophy (the Shastras) Yogis and solitarians have gone astray in doubt, without the Guru.
QM6W: If they serve the True Guru, they find the state of salvation; they enshrine the Dear Lord within their minds.
If they serve the True Guru, then alone, do they find salvation and way to the Lord and imbibe reverend God in their minds.
Z65D: They focus their consciousness on the True Bani, and their comings and goings in reincarnation are over. ||5||
With the True Gurbani their mind is fixed and their coming and going cease.
3XP2: The Pandits, the religious scholars, read and argue and stir up controversies, but without the Guru, they are deluded by doubt.
By reading and studying the Brahmas set afoot controversies, and without the Guru they go amiss in scepticism.
W7JP: They wander around the cycle of 8.4 million reincarnations; without the Shabad, they do not attain liberation.
They go round in the circuit of eight-four lakhs of existences and sans the Name obtain not salvation.
CRLW: But when they remember the Name, then they attain the state of salvation, when the True Guru unites them in Union. ||6||
When they remember the Name and when the True Guru unites them with Lord's union, then do they attain to emanicipation.8
BABH: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Name of the Lord wells up, when the True Guru unites us in His Sublime Love.
When by virtue of good faith the True Guru meets, the Name of God emanates in the saints' congregation.

DGZD: I offer my mind and body, and I renounce my selfishness and conceit; I walk in Harmony with the Will of the True Guru.
I offer my soul and body, give up my self-conceit and act according to True Guru's will.
G9KK: I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, who has attached my consciousness to the Lord. ||7||
I am ever a sacrifice to my Guru who attaches my soul with the Lord.
V29C: He alone is a Brahmin, who knows the Lord Brahma, and is attuned to the Love of the Lord.
He is a Brahman who knows the Lord and is imbued with the love of God.
9RTE: God is close at hand; He dwells deep within the hearts of all. How rare are those who, as Gurmukh, know Him.
The Lord abides near within the hearts of all. Hardly any one knows Him through the Guru.
PWTE: O Nanak, through the Naam, greatness is obtained; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is realized. ||8||5||22||
Nanak by God's Name one receives honour, and by Gurbani he recognises the Lord.
P0FV: Everyone longs to be centered and balanced, but without the Guru, no one can.
All long for the state of Equipoise but without the Guru it cannot be obtained.
3KDS: The Pandits and the astrologers read and read until they grow weary, while the fanatics are deluded by doubt.
The Pandits and astrologers have grown weary of extensive reading and the sectarians go amiss in scepticism.
9ESB: Meeting with the Guru, intuitive balance is obtained, when God, in His Will, grants His Grace. ||1||
If the Lord of will showers His benediction the state of Poise is attained by meeting the Guru.
UKQD: O Siblings of Destiny, without the Guru, intuitive balance is not obtained.
O Brother! without the Guru, no Equipoise can be obtained.
A5HG: Through the Word of the Shabad, intuitive peace and poise wells up, and that True Lord is obtained. ||1||Pause||
It is from the Divine Word that Poise proceeds and that True God is obtained. Pause.
NG7Z: That which is sung intuitively is acceptable; without this intuition, all chanting is useless.
What is sung in Divine comprehension becomes acceptable. Without divine comprehension the recitation is in vain.
T926: In the state of intuitive balance, devotion wells up. In intuitive balance, love is balanced and detached.
It is by Divine knowledge that devotion emanates and by Divine knowledge love of God and detachment from the world are produced.
HVD6: In the state of intuitive balance, peace and tranquility are produced. Without intuitive balance, life is useless. ||2||
From Divine knowledge bliss and peace ensue and without Divine knowledge the life is in vain.
GVMH: In the state of intuitive balance, praise the Lord forever and ever. With intuitive ease, embrace Samaadhi.
In celestial repose, ever and ever, you praise the Lord and in celestial repose you embrace trance.
A6A1: In the state of intuitive balance, chant His Glories, lovingly absorbed in devotional worship.
In Divine repose, mortal utters God's praises and lovingly performs His service.
CGUA: Through the Shabad, the Lord dwells within the mind, and the tongue tastes the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||
Through the Word God dwells in the mind and the tongue tastes God's Nectar.
LL9U: In the poise of intuitive balance, death is destroyed, entering the Sanctuary of the True One.
By entering the sanctuary of the True One, death is easily destroyed.
4YKA: Intuitively balanced, the Name of the Lord dwells within the mind, practicing the lifestyle of Truth.
If the mortal practises the True way of life, God's Name easily abides in his mind.
G0X3: Those who have found Him are very fortunate; they remain intuitively absorbed in Him. ||4||
Exceedingly fortunate are they who have found God and easily remain absorbed in Him.
X9QG: Within Maya, the poise of intuitive balance is not produced. Maya leads to the love of duality.
In Maya (wordly attachment) mental equilibrium springs not. The wordly attachment produces duality.
ZHRC: The self-willed manmukhs perform religious rituals, but they are burnt down by their selfishness and conceit.
The wayward perform religious rites but they burnt down by self-conceitedness.
H4D9: Their births and deaths do not cease; over and over again, they come and go in reincarnation. ||5||
Their birth and death cease not. They come and go again and again.
CZ49: In the three qualities, intuitive balance is not obtained; the three qualities lead to delusion and doubt.
In three dispositions Equipoise is not obtained. The three modes lead astray the mortal in doubt.
EKZ9: What is the point of reading, studying and debating, if one loses his roots?
What do reading, studying, and talking avail a man he misses the very Origin?
3E7T: In the fourth state, there is intuitive balance; the Gurmukhs gather it in. ||6||
In the fourth state there is Spiritual Bliss and the Guruwards obtain it in their sheet.
FU1P: The Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, is the treasure. Through intuitive balance, understanding is obtained.
In the Name of the attributeless Lord there is treasure. Through Divine comprehension Knowledge is obtained.
PLQB: The virtuous praise the True One; their reputation is true.
The virtuous, praise God saying "True is the reputation of the True One".
Y5H4: The wayward are united with God through intuitive balance; through the Shabad, union is obtained. ||7||
The Lord unites even the stayers. It is through the Name that union is accomplished.
NWFZ: Without intuitive balance, all are blind. Emotional attachment to Maya is utter darkness.
Without Divine Knowledge all are blind. The love of mammon is pitch darkness.
0E7W: In intuitive balance, understanding of the True, Infinite Shabad is obtained.
Through Divine Knowledge understanding of the Infinite True Lord is obtained.
MHQN: Granting forgiveness, the Perfect Guru unites us with the Creator. ||8||
Himself granting pardon the Perfect Guru unites man with the Creator.
6G03: In intuitive balance, the Unseen is recognized-the Fearless, Luminous, Formless Lord.
Through Equipoise the Unseen, Fearless, Luminous and Formless Lord is recognised.
BCNP: There is only the One Giver of all beings. He blends our light with His Light.
Of all the beings, there is but One Bestower. The Luminous Lord is the blender of man's light with Himself.
V2S0: So praise God through the Perfect Word of His Shabad; He has no end or limitation. ||9||
By means of the Perfect Word, praise you the Lord, who has no limit and this or that end.
HG4A: Those who are wise take the Naam as their wealth; with intuitive ease, they trade with Him.
The Wise in God have Lord's Name as their wealth and through poise do they have traffic with Him.
QXH6: Night and day, they receive the Profit of the Lord's Name, which is an inexhaustible and over-flowing treasure.
By night and day, they receive the profit of God's name whose treasures are brimful and inexhaustible.9
S5E8: O Nanak, when the Great Giver gives, nothing at all is lacking. ||10||6||23||
Nanak, when the Giver gives there occurs no deficiency.

MNLD: Meeting with the True Guru, you shall not have to go through the cycle of reincarnation again; the pains of birth and death will be taken away.
By meeting the Sat Guru one is not cast to the round and his pain of birth and death is removed.
KH3F: Through the Perfect Word of the Shabad, all understanding is obtained; remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Through perfect Guru's word entire understanding is gained, and man remains absorbed in God's Name.
7D7V: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the True Guru.
O my mind! fix your attention with (on) the True Guru.
N3FA: The Immaculate Naam itself, ever-fresh, comes to abide within the mind. ||1||Pause||
The immaculate and ever fresh Name of Itself, comes and abides within the saints' mind. Pause.
N2TV: O Dear Lord, please protect and preserve me in Your Sanctuary. As You keep me, so do I remain.
O venerable God! keep me in Yours sanctuary, where -in I shall live as You shall keep me.
3XUS: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Gurmukh remains dead while yet alive, and swims across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
Through Guru's Word the pious person remains dead in life and thus swims across the dreadful ocean of the world.
7NZX: By great good fortune, the Name is obtained. Following the Guru's Teachings, through the Shabad, you shall be exalted.
By great good fortune man receives the Name and by Guru's wisdom, enshrined in Gurbani, he looks beauteous.
YYGH: God, the Creator Himself, dwells within the mind; remain absorbed in the state of intuitive balance. ||3||
Lord, the Creator, Himself dwells in his mind, and he remains absorbed in celestial beatitude.
X4MB: Some are self-willed manmukhs; they do not love the Word of the Shabad. Bound in chains, they wander lost in reincarnation.
Some egocentrics like not Lord's Name. Loaded with chains they are goaded into species.
GGCM: Through 8.4 million lifetimes, they wander over and over again; they waste away their lives in vain. ||4||
They return after repeatedly wandering in eight-four lakhs of existences and waste their life in vain.
1ZXY: In the minds of the devotees there is bliss; they are attuned to the Love of the True Word of the Shabad.
Within the mind of His devotees there is bliss. They are imbued with the love of the True Lord.
83R5: Night and day, they constantly sing the Glories of the Immaculate Lord; with intuitive ease, they are absorbed into the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||5||
Night and day, they the Pure Ones ever sing the praises and are easily absorbed in his Name.
15P2: The Gurmukhs speak the Ambrosial Bani; they recognize the Lord, the Supreme Soul in all.
The True Sikhs of the Guru recite the ambrosial Word and recognise the Pervading Lord among all the hearts.
UWNM: They serve the One; they worship and adore the One. The Gurmukhs speak the Unspoken Speech. ||6||
Only One (God) do they serve, and One do they meditate upon. Ineffable is the discourse of the true Sikhs of the Guru.
KS5S: The Gurmukhs serve their True Lord and Master, who comes to dwell in the mind.
The Guruwards serve the True Lord, who comes and takes abode in their heart.
3FEH: They are forever attuned to the Love of the True One, who bestows His Mercy and unites them with Himself. ||7||
They ever remain imbued with the love of the True Being who by showering His benediction, unites them with Himself.
KM8Y: He Himself does, and He Himself causes others to do; He wakes some from their sleep.
